## 2. 関数：世帯構成員の算出

```{r}

# ******************************************************************************
# @title: get_familysize_ame
# @description: 世帯構成員の年齢と性別に基づく家族メンバー数（adult male equivalent）
# @param df_mod4: ENAHOのmod4データフレーム
# @return: 世帯ごとの家族メンバー数と成人男性換算のデータフレーム 
# ******************************************************************************
get_familysize_ame <- function(df_mod4, df_AME){
  # 年齢計算関数のベクトル化対応版
  calculate_age_vectorized <- function(year1, month1, year2, month2) {
    # ベクトル全体でのNA検証
    if(any(is.na(year1) | is.na(month1) | is.na(year2) | is.na(month2))) {
      warning("Some input values contain NA")
    }
    
    # 1. 暦年差
    age_years <- year2 - year1
    
    # 2. 暦月差  
    raw_months <- month2 - month1
    
    # 3. 月差の調整（ベクトル化対応）
    age_years <- ifelse(raw_months < 0, age_years - 1, age_years)
    age_months <- ifelse(raw_months < 0, raw_months + 12, raw_months)
    
    # 4. 年齢のみを返す
    return(age_years)
  }
  
  
  # 家族メンバーの計算(AMEの利用)
  df_family_size <- df_mod4 %>%
    mutate(
      P400A2 = ifelse(is.na(P400A2), "6", P400A2),
      P400A3 = ifelse(is.na(P400A3), "1990", P400A3)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      age = calculate_age_vectorized(as.numeric(P400A3), as.numeric(P400A2), 
                          as.numeric(AÑO), as.numeric(MES)) %>%
      labelled(
        label = "Age of household members"
      ),
      sex_char = ifelse(P207 == 1, "male", "female") %>%
      labelled(
        label = "Sex of household members"
      )
    ) %>%
    # 効率的な結合を使用
    left_join(
      df_AME %>% select(age_min, age_max, sex, AEQ),
      by = c("sex_char" = "sex"),  # 正しい構文
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    filter(age_min < age & age_max >= age) %>%
    group_by(row_number()) %>%
    slice(1) %>%  # 最初のマッチを選択
    ungroup() %>%
    rename(adult_male_equivalent = AEQ) %>%
    select(-age_min, -age_max, -sex_char) %>%
    summarise(
      family_size = n() %>%
        labelled(
          label = "Number of household members"
        ),
      family_size_ame = sum(adult_male_equivalent) %>%
        labelled(
          label = "Family size in Adult, Male Equivalent (AME)"
        ),
      .by = all_of(grouping_vars)
    )

  return(df_family_size)  
}

```

## 3. 関数：世帯の食品群の消費量計算

```{r}
# ------関数ここまで----------------------------------------------------------
# ******************************************************************************
# @title: get_food_consumption_base_dt
# @description: 世帯の1日あたり食材消費量の計算（データテーブル版）
#  高速化のためにデータテーブルを使用
# @param df_mod7: ENAHOのmod7データフレーム
# @return: 世帯の1日あたり食材消費量のデータフレーム
# ******************************************************************************
get_food_consumption_base_dt <- function(df){
  cat("Calculating food consumption per family (data.table optimized)...\n")
  
  # data.table変換
  dt <- as.data.table(df)
  
  # ============================================================
  # ステップ1: 数値変換（ベクトル演算）
  # ============================================================
  dt[, `:=`(
    P601B2 = as.numeric(P601B2),
    P601D2 = as.numeric(P601D2)
  )]
  
  # ============================================================
  # ステップ2: frequency_days計算（fcaseで高速化）
  # ============================================================
  dt[, frequency_days := fcase(
    P601D1 == 1, 15.0,      # Daily
    P601D1 == 2, 7.5,       # Every other day
    P601D1 == 3, 2.14,      # Weekly
    P601D1 == 4, 1.07,      # Biweekly
    P601D1 == 5, 0.5,       # Monthly
    P601D1 == 9, 4.29,      # Twice a week
    P601D1 == 10, 6.43,     # Three times a week
    is.na(P601D1), 15.0,    # NA → デフォルト
    default = 15.0          # その他もデフォルト
  )]
  
  # ============================================================
  # ステップ3: food_unit計算（fcaseで高速化）
  # ============================================================
  # 条件が多いため、可読性を保つために適切に改行
  dt[, food_unit := fcase(
    P601D3 == 1, 300,       # bread (grams)
    P601D3 == 2, 1,         # gram
    P601D3 == 3, 800,       # large sliced bread loaf
    P601D3 == 5, 400,       # small sliced bread loaf
    P601D3 == 8, 200,       # small sponge cake
    P601D3 == 9, 1000,      # kilogram
    P601D3 == 11, 1030,     # liter
    P601D3 == 12, 500,      # large_can(milk)
    P601D3 == 13, 250,      # small_can(milk)
    P601D3 == 14, 170,      # 魚缶詰
    P601D3 == 15, 750,      # beer, champagne
    P601D3 == 16, 750,      # beer, champagne
    P601D3 == 17, 750,      # beer, champagne
    P601D3 == 24, 200,      # セロリ
    P601D3 == 29, 100,      # ティーバッグ
    P601D3 == 30, 100,      # 魚のフィレ
    P601D3 == 32, 100,      # 魚の缶詰
    default = 1000          # default to kilogram
  )]
  
  # ============================================================
  # ステップ4: daily_consumption計算（ベクトル演算）
  # ============================================================
  dt[, daily_consumption := P601D2 * food_unit / frequency_days]
  
  # ============================================================
  # ステップ5: 列選択と順序整理
  # ============================================================
  # 必要な列を定義
  keep_cols <- c("CONGLOME", "VIVIENDA", "HOGAR", "UBIGEO", "DOMINIO", 
                 "ESTRATO", "FACTOR07", "food_item_code", "frequency_days", 
                 "food_unit", "daily_consumption", "label_food", 
                 "code_food_grp", "label_food_grp", "code_fbdg", "label_fbdg")
  
  # 存在する列のみを選択
  final_cols <- intersect(keep_cols, names(dt))
  
  # 列順を設定
  setcolorder(dt, final_cols)
  
  # 不要な列を削除
  dt <- dt[, ..final_cols]
  
  cat("Food consumption per family complete (data.table optimized).\n")
  return(dt)
}
# ------関数ここまで----------------------------------------------------------
# ******************************************************************************
# @title: get_food_consumption_capita_dt
# @description: 世帯の食材グループ別の一人当たり1日あたり消費量の計算
#  高速化のためにデータテーブルを使用し、二重分類体系（food_grpとfbdg）に対応）
# @param df_fooditem_consumption: 世帯の食材別の1日あたり消費量のデータフレーム
# @param df_family_size: 世帯ごとの家族メンバー数と成人男性換算のデータフレーム
# @return: 世帯の食材グループ別の一人当たり1日あたり消費量のデータフレーム
# ******************************************************************************

get_food_consumption_capita_dt <- function(df_fooditem_consumption, df_family_size){
  cat("Calculating food consumption per capita (dual classification)...\n")
  
  # ============================================================
  # 処理1: code_food_grp/label_food_grp の集計とワイド変換
  # ============================================================
  dt <- as.data.table(df_fooditem_consumption)
  
  # ============================================================
  # ステップ1：食品群単位での集計
  # ============================================================
  dt_agg_fg <- dt[, .(daily_consumption_g = sum(daily_consumption, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  by = .(CONGLOME, VIVIENDA, HOGAR, UBIGEO, DOMINIO,
                         ESTRATO, FACTOR07, code_food_grp, label_food_grp)]
  
  # ============================================================
  # ステップ2：ピボット（ワイド型変換）（プレフィックス "fg_" を追加）
  # ============================================================
  dt_wide_fg <- dcast(dt_agg_fg, 
                      CONGLOME + VIVIENDA + HOGAR + UBIGEO + DOMINIO + 
                      ESTRATO + FACTOR07 ~ label_food_grp,
                      value.var = "daily_consumption_g", fill = NA_real_)
  
  # 列名にプレフィックスを追加
  food_grp_cols <- setdiff(names(dt_wide_fg), 
                           c("CONGLOME", "VIVIENDA", "HOGAR", "UBIGEO", 
                             "DOMINIO", "ESTRATO", "FACTOR07"))
  setnames(dt_wide_fg, food_grp_cols, paste0("fg_", food_grp_cols))
  
  # 変数ラベルを作成
  # 食品群列用のラベルリストを作る
  fg_label_list <- as.list(
    sprintf(
      "Daily food consumption in grams per family (food group - %s)",
      food_grp_cols
    )
  )
  names(fg_label_list) <- paste0("fg_", food_grp_cols)
  # var_label(dt_wide_fg) <- fg_label_list
  # ============================================================
  # 処理2: code_fbdg/label_fbdg の集計とワイド変換
  # ============================================================
  # fbdg 集計（同じデータから、異なる分類で集計）
  dt_agg_fb <- dt[, .(daily_consumption_g = sum(daily_consumption, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  by = .(CONGLOME, VIVIENDA, HOGAR, UBIGEO, DOMINIO,
                         ESTRATO, FACTOR07, code_fbdg, label_fbdg)]
  
  # fbdg ワイド変換（プレフィックス "fbdg_" を追加）
  dt_wide_fb <- dcast(dt_agg_fb, 
                      CONGLOME + VIVIENDA + HOGAR + UBIGEO + DOMINIO + 
                      ESTRATO + FACTOR07 ~ label_fbdg,
                      value.var = "daily_consumption_g", fill = NA_real_)
  
  # 列名にプレフィックスを追加
  fbdg_cols <- setdiff(names(dt_wide_fb), 
                       c("CONGLOME", "VIVIENDA", "HOGAR", "UBIGEO", 
                         "DOMINIO", "ESTRATO", "FACTOR07"))
  setnames(dt_wide_fb, fbdg_cols, paste0("fbdg_", fbdg_cols))
  
  # 変数ラベルを作成
  # 食品群列用のラベルリストを作る
  fbdg_label_list <- as.list(
    sprintf(
      "Daily food consumption in grams per family (fbdg group - %s)",
      fbdg_cols
    )
  )
  names(fbdg_label_list) <- paste0("fbdg_", fbdg_cols)
  # var_label(dt_wide_fb) <- fbdg_label_list

  # ============================================================
  # 処理3: 両分類体系の結合
  # ============================================================
  # キーで結合（full joinではなくleft join）
  dt_combined <- merge(dt_wide_fg, dt_wide_fb,
                       by = c("CONGLOME", "VIVIENDA", "HOGAR", "UBIGEO", 
                              "DOMINIO", "ESTRATO", "FACTOR07"),
                       all = TRUE,  # どちらかにデータがあれば保持
                       suffixes = c("_fg", "_fbdg"))  # 衝突時のサフィックス
  
  # ============================================================
  # 処理4: 0→NA置換（outlier処理:両分類体系の列に対して）
  # 【重要】このタイミングで0をNAに変換することで：
  # ・各食品群は独立に0判定されるため、
  #   一方が0でも他方は保持される
  # ・後続分析でのfilter()が容易になる
  # ============================================================
  # food_grp 列を取得
  fg_cols <- names(dt_combined)[grep("^fg_", names(dt_combined))]
  
  # fbdg 列を取得
  fbdg_cols <- names(dt_combined)[grep("^fbdg_", names(dt_combined))]
  
  # 0→NA置換（food_grp列）
  dt_combined[, (fg_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) fifelse(x == 0, NA_real_, x)),
              .SDcols = fg_cols]
  
  # 0→NA置換（fbdg列）
  dt_combined[, (fbdg_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) fifelse(x == 0, NA_real_, x)),
              .SDcols = fbdg_cols]
  
  # ============================================================
  # 処理5: staple_legume計算（food_grpを使用）
  # 【ロジック】
  # ・成分が全てNA → staple_legume = NA
  # ・成分にいずれか実データあり → 実データのみで合計
  # これにより、grains=NA, root=100なら合計は100となる
  # ============================================================
  # food_grpの主食・豆類列を使用
  staple_fg_cols <- c("fg_grains", "fg_root", "fg_nuts")
  
  dt_combined[, staple_legume := {
    all_na <- is.na(fg_grains) & is.na(fg_root) & is.na(fg_nuts)
    fifelse(all_na, NA_real_, 
            rowSums(.SD[, ..staple_fg_cols], na.rm = TRUE))
  }]
  
  # 変数ラベル設定
  var_label(dt_combined$staple_legume) <- 
    "Daily food consumption in grams per family (staple and legume)"
  
  # ============================================================
  # 処理6: 一人当たり変換
  # ============================================================
  # 家族サイズデータと結合
  dt_final <- merge(dt_combined, df_family_size,
                    by = c("CONGLOME", "VIVIENDA", "HOGAR"),
                    all.x = TRUE)
  
  # 全食品列（food_grp + fbdg + staple_legume）で除算
  all_food_cols <- c(fg_cols, fbdg_cols, "staple_legume")
  
  dt_final[, paste0(all_food_cols, "_capita") := 
           lapply(.SD, function(x) x / family_size_ame),
           .SDcols = all_food_cols]
  
  # 元の列を削除（オプション）
  dt_final[, (all_food_cols) := NULL]
  
  # ============================================================
  # 処理7: ラベル統合と適用（最終段階）
  # ============================================================
  # ステップ1: 3つのラベル情報源を統合
  final_label_list <- c(
    fg_label_list,           # food_grp列のラベル
    fbdg_label_list,         # fbdg列のラベル
    list(staple_legume = "Daily food consumption in grams per family (staple and legume)")
  )
  
  # ステップ2: _capitaサフィックスを追加（最終列名に合わせる）
  names(final_label_list) <- paste0(names(final_label_list), "_capita")

  # ステップ2: dt_finalに適用
  var_label(dt_final) <- final_label_list
  
  
  cat("Food consumption per capita calculation complete (dual classification).\n")
  return(dt_final)
}
# ------関数ここまで----------------------------------------------------------

# ******************************************************************************
# @title: add_area_department
# @description: 地域区分と県コードの追加
# @param df: 食品群の1人1日あたり消費量のデータフレーム
# @return: 地域区分と県コードが追加されたデータフレーム
# ******************************************************************************
add_area_department <- function(df){
  # 地域区分の追加
  cat("data processing: add region and department info...\n")
  
  # 地域対応ベクトル
  costa <- c("01","02","03","04","05","13","15","18","19","21")
  sierra <- c("06","07","08","09","10","11","12","14","16","17","20")
  selva <- c("22","23","24","25")


  result <- df %>%
  mutate(
    rural_urban = case_when(
      ESTRATO %in% 1:6 ~ "1",
      ESTRATO %in% 7:8 ~ "2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # NA_real_ではなくNA_character_の方が適切
     ) %>%
      labelled(
        labels = c("Urban" = "1", "Rural" = "2"),
        label = "Area: Urban or Rural"
      ) %>% as.factor(),
    department = substr(UBIGEO, 1, 2) %>%
      labelled(
        labels = c(
          "01" = "Amazonas", "02" = "Ancash", "03" = "Apurimac", 
          "04" = "Arequipa", "05" = "Ayacucho", "06" = "Cajamarca", 
          "07" = "Callao", "08" = "Cusco", "09" = "Huancavelica", 
          "10" = "Huanuco", "11" = "Ica", "12" = "Junin", 
          "13" = "La Libertad", "14" = "Lambayeque", 
          "15" = "Lima", "16" = "Loreto", 
          "17" = "Madre de Dios", "18" = "Moquegua", 
          "19" = "Pasco",  "20" = "Piura", 
          "21" = "Puno",  "22" = "San Martin", 
          "23" =  "Tacna",  "24" =  "Tumbes", 
          "25" =  "Ucayali"
        ),
        label = "Department code"
      ) %>% as.factor()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
      region = case_when(
        department %in% costa ~ "Coast",
        department %in% sierra ~ "Sierra",
        department %in% selva ~ "Selva",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_  # NA_real_ではなくNA_character_の方が適切
      ) %>%
        labelled(
          labels = c("Coast" = "Coast", "Sierra" = "Highland", "Selva" = "Amazon"),
          label = "Region: Coast, Highland, or Amazon"
        ) %>% as.factor()
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    area = interaction(department, rural_urban, sep = ":") %>%
      labelled(
        label = "Area: Department and Urban/Rural"
      ) %>% as.factor()
  ) %>%
  # 家庭データにCRECERの介入情報を結合
  left_join(df_intervention_timing, by = c("department" = "department_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    treated_status = case_when(
      # 早期開始州かつ2009年以降
      year_treated == 2009 & as.numeric(year) >= 2009 ~ "early_treated", 

      # 後期開始州かつ2011年以降
      year_treated == 2011 & as.numeric(year) >= 2011 ~ "late_treated",   

      # 将来的にtreatedになるが年が到達していない
      !is.na(year_treated) ~ "not_yet_treated",  

      # どれにも該当しない
      is.na(year_treated) ~ "never_treated",                              

      # その他（念のため）
      TRUE ~ "other"                                                      
    ) %>%
    labelled(
      labels = c(
        "early_treated" = "Early Treated (from 2009)",
        "late_treated" = "Late Treated (from 2011)",
        "not_yet_treated" = "Not Yet Treated",
        "never_treated" = "Never Treated"
      ),
      label = "Treated status based on intervention timing"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_group = case_when(
      treated_status == "early_treated"|
      treated_status == "late_treated" ~ "treatment_grp",
      treated_status == "never_treated" |
      treated_status == "not_yet_treated"~ "control_grp",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>%
    labelled(
      labels = c(
        "treatment_grp" = "Treatment Group 1/2 (2009/2011)",
        "control_grp" = "Control Group"
      ),
      label = "Group based on treatment timing"
    ) %>% as.factor()
 )
cat("region/department data completed.\n")

return(result)
}
# ------関数ここまで----------------------------------------------------------
# ******************************************************************************
# @title: add_income
# @description: 所得の追加
# @param df1: 食品群の1人1日あたり消費量のデータフレーム
# @param df2: 所得データのデータフレーム（デフォルトはdf_summary）
# @return: 所得が追加されたデータフレーム
# ******************************************************************************
add_income <- function(df1, df2, grouping_vars){
  cat("data processing: add income...\n")
  result <- df1 %>%
  left_join(
    df2 %>%
      select(grouping_vars, INGHOG2D),
    by = grouping_vars
  ) %>%
  rename(
    income_net = INGHOG2D
  )
  cat("income data completed.\n")
return(result)
}
# ------関数ここまで----------------------------------------------------------
# ******************************************************************************
# @title: add_juntos
# @description: JUNTOS参加情報の追加（世帯レベルへの集計機能付き）
# @param df1: 食品群の1人1日あたり消費量のデータフレーム
# @param df2: JUNTOSデータのデータフレーム（デフォルトはdf_mod5）
# @return: JUNTOS参加情報が追加されたデータフレーム
# ******************************************************************************
add_juntos <- function(df1, df2, grouping_vars){
  cat("data processing: add JUNTOS participation info...\n")
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # ステップ1: df2 (mod5) を世帯レベルに集計
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # P5566A: 1 = Participant, 2 = Non-participant
  # 世帯内に一人でも "1" がいれば参加世帯とみなす
  
  df2_agg <- df2 %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(grouping_vars))) %>%
    summarise(
      # 参加フラグ: 1が一つでもあれば TRUE
      has_participant = any(P5566A == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # 金額: 世帯合計 (NAは0扱いまたは無視)
      total_amount = sum(P5566C, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # ステップ2: 結合と変数の整形
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  result <- df1 %>%
    left_join(df2_agg, by = grouping_vars) %>%
    mutate(
      juntos_participation = case_when(
        has_participant == TRUE ~ "participant",
        TRUE ~ "non_participant"  # データがない、または全員2の場合
      ) %>%
      labelled(
        labels = c(
          "participant" = "JUNTOS Participant",
          "non_participant" = "Non-participant"
        ),
        label = "JUNTOS Participation Status (Household)"
      ) %>% as.factor(),
      
      juntos_amount = total_amount %>%
      labelled(
        label = "Total Amount received from JUNTOS program (in PEN)"
      )
    ) %>%
    # 一時変数の削除
    select(-has_participant, -total_amount)

  cat("JUNTOS participation data completed.\n")
  return(result)
}
# ------関数ここまで----------------------------------------------------------
# ******************************************************************************
# @title: add_food_score
# @description: 食品群ごとの摂取基準に基づくスコアの追加
# @param df: 食品群の1人1日あたり消費量のデータフレーム
# @param myVar: スコアを追加する変数名のベクトル
# @param fbdg_threshold: 食品群ごとの摂取基準のリスト
# @return: スコアが追加されたデータフレーム
# ******************************************************************************
add_food_score <- function(df, myVar, fbdg_threshold, prefix = "fbdg_", suffix = "_capita"){
  # dfに存在する実際の列名を構築
  actual_cols <- paste0(prefix, myVar, suffix)
  
  # 存在チェック
  missing_cols <- actual_cols[!actual_cols %in% names(df)]
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Following columns not found in df: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # fbdgの推奨値をリスト化
  fbdg_lower <- map_dbl(fbdg_threshold, ~ 0.9 * .x)
  fbdg_upper <- map_dbl(fbdg_threshold, ~ 1.1 * .x)
  
  # myVarとactual_colsの対応マップを作成
  names(fbdg_lower) <- actual_cols
  names(fbdg_upper) <- actual_cols

  # スコア列の追加
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(actual_cols),
      ~ {
          var <- cur_column()
          lower <- fbdg_lower[[var]]
          upper <- fbdg_upper[[var]]
          case_when(
            . >= lower & . < upper ~ 1,
            . >= upper             ~ 2,
            . < lower              ~ 3,
            TRUE                   ~ NA_real_
          )
      },
      .names = "{.col}_score"
    )) %>%

    mutate(across(ends_with("_score"),
      ~ {
        case_when(
          . == 1 ~ 1,
          . == 2 ~ 0,
          . == 3 ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
      },
      .names = "{.col}_optimal")) %>%

    mutate(across(ends_with("_score"),
      ~ labelled(
          .,
          labels = c(
            "Meets recommendation" = 1,
            "Exceeds recommendation" = 2,
            "Below recommendation" = 3
          ),
          label = paste0("Food consumption score based on FBDG")
        )
    )) %>%
    mutate(across(ends_with("_optimal"),
      ~ labelled(
          .,
          labels = c(
            "Optimal consumption" = 1,
            "Non-optimal consumption" = 0
          ),
          label = paste0("Optimal food consumption indicator based on FBDG")
        )
    ))

  return(df)
}
# ------関数ここまで----------------------------------------------------------

```
## 4. 関数：log変数の追加

```{r}
# ******************************************************************************
# @title: set_log1p_vars
# @description: 指定された変数群のlog1p変数を追加
# @param df: データフレーム
# @param vars: log1p変数を追加する変数名のベクトル
# @return: log1p変数が追加されたsvydesignオブジェクト
# ******************************************************************************
set_log1p_vars <- function(df, vars) {
  df_log <- df
  for (var in vars){
    # # 実際の列名を構築
    # actual_col <- paste0(prefix, var, suffix)
    
    # 列の存在チェック
    if (!var %in% names(df_log)) {
      stop("Column '", var, "' not found in dataframe")
    }
    
    df_log[[paste0(var, "_log1p")]] <- labelled(
      log1p(df_log[[var]]),
      label = paste0("Log-transformed ", var)
    )
  }
  return(df_log)
}
# ------関数ここまで----------------------------------------------------------
```

## 5. 全体ループ

```{r}
library(haven)
library(data.table)
library(labelled)

# 結果保存用データフレーム
df_food_org <- data.frame()

# 必要な食品コードの一覧
food_item_code <- c("P601A", "P601X", "P601B1", "P601B2",
                    "P601B3", "P601D1", "P601D2", "P601D3")

year_current <- "2012"

# ******************************************************************************
# 年次ループ開始
# ******************************************************************************
for(year_current in yearlist){
  print("========================================")
  print(paste0("Processing year: ", year_current))
  print("========================================")

  # ******************************************************************************
  # 初期変数の設定
  # ******************************************************************************
  if (year_current %in% c("2011","2012","2013","2014","2015","2016")) {
    # "P601X" を除外する（s は未定義なので使わない）
    food_item_code <- setdiff(food_item_code, "P601X")
  }
  
  # mod7で必要な列を抽出
  required_key_mod7 <- c(food_item_code,
         "CONGLOME", "VIVIENDA", "HOGAR", "UBIGEO", "DOMINIO", "ESTRATO",
          "FACTOR07", "year")
  required_key_mod5 <- c("P5566A", "P5566C", "CONGLOME", "VIVIENDA", "HOGAR",
          "year")

  # データ保存先フォルダ
  save_folder <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year_current)
  if (!dir.exists(save_folder)){
    dir.create(save_folder, recursive = TRUE)
  }


  # ******************************************************************************
  # データの読み込み
  # ******************************************************************************
  cat("loading ENAHO data files mod1...\n")
  df_mod1 <- open_enaho_file(year_current, "mod1") %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year_current))
  
  cat("loading ENAHO data files mod4...\n")
  df_mod4 <- open_enaho_file(year_current, "mod4") %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year_current))
  
  cat("loading ENAHO data files mod5...\n")
  df_mod5 <- open_enaho_file(year_current, "mod5") %>%
    rename_with(toupper) %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year_current)) %>%
    select(all_of(required_key_mod5))
  
  # メモリ管理のためmod7に必要な列のみを残す
  cat("loading ENAHO data files mod7...\n")
  df_mod7 <- open_enaho_file(year_current, "mod7") %>%
    rename_with(toupper) %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year_current)) %>%
    select(all_of(required_key_mod7))
  gc()

  # P601A をラベル解除して数値列を先に作る
  df_mod7$P601A_num <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(df_mod7$P601A))
  
  # これで参照しても警告は出ない
  expenditure_item <- unique(df_mod7$P601A_num)
  
  df_summary <- open_enaho_file(year_current, "summary") %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year_current))

  # ******************************************************************************
  # デバッグモード時は変数ラベルを取得、保存:ここは後で削除する
  # ******************************************************************************
  if (is_debug_mode){
    setlabels <- function(df, year, file) {
      temp_labels <- getLabelfromDF(df) %>%
      mutate(year = year, file = file) 
      return(temp_labels)
    }
  
    var_labels <- setlabels(df_mod1, year_current, "mod1") %>%
      bind_rows(setlabels(df_mod4, year_current, "mod4")) %>%
      bind_rows(setlabels(df_mod7, year_current, "mod7")) %>%
      bind_rows(setlabels(df_summary, year_current, "summary"))
    
    write.xlsx(var_labels, file = file.path(save_folder, "var_labels.xlsx"))
  }

  # ******************************************************************************
  # 家族メンバー数（AME）の計算
  # ******************************************************************************
  df_family_size <- get_familysize_ame(df_mod4, df_AME)
  
  # ******************************************************************************
  # 食品群の消費量計算
  # ******************************************************************************

  df_food_consumption <- df_mod7 %>%
    left_join(df_food_grp, by = c("P601A_num" = "code_food"))

  
  # 食品群の家族単位の1日あたり消費量の計算
  df_food_consumption <- get_food_consumption_base_dt(df_food_consumption)
  
  # 食品群の1人1日あたり消費量の計算
  df_foodgrp_consumption_capita <- 
    get_food_consumption_capita_dt(df_food_consumption, df_family_size)
 

  # 地域区分と県コードの追加
  df_foodgrp_consumption_capita <-
      add_area_department(df_foodgrp_consumption_capita)
  
  # 所得の追加
  df_foodgrp_consumption_capita <- add_income(df_foodgrp_consumption_capita,
      df_summary, grouping_vars)

  # JUNTOS参加情報の追加
  df_foodgrp_consumption_capita <- add_juntos(df_foodgrp_consumption_capita,
      df_mod5, grouping_vars)
  
　# log変数の作成
  cols_1 <- paste0("fg_", myVar_foodgrp, "_capita")
  cols_2 <- paste0("fbdg_", myVar_fbdg, "_capita")
  df_foodgrp_consumption_capita <- set_log1p_vars(df_foodgrp_consumption_capita,
      c(cols_1, cols_2))
  
  # 食品群ごとの摂取基準に基づくスコアの追加
  # log1pでなくrawデータを利用
  df_foodgrp_consumption_capita <- add_food_score(
    df_foodgrp_consumption_capita, myVar_fbdg, fbdg_threshold)

  # ******************************************************************************
  # 結果保存のため結合 
  # ******************************************************************************
  # 
  # 両方をcharacter型に統一
  df_foodgrp_consumption_capita <- df_foodgrp_consumption_capita %>%
    mutate(ESTRATO = as.character(ESTRATO))

  df_food_org <- df_food_org %>%
    bind_rows(
      df_foodgrp_consumption_capita
    )


  cat("========================================\n")
  cat(paste0("Year ", year_current, " processing completed.\n"))
  cat("========================================\n")
  
}

gc()

# ********************************************************************************
# 年次データをpoolするための準備
# 年次データをpoolするために、svydesignの重み、PSU, strataを更新
# ********************************************************************************
df_food_org <- df_food_org %>%
  mutate(
    FACTOR07 = FACTOR07 / length(unique(year)),  # 重みの年次平均化
    CONGLOME = as.factor(paste0(year, "_", CONGLOME)),  # PSUの年次識別子付与
    ESTRATO = as.factor(paste0(year, "_", ESTRATO))   # strataの年次識別子付与
  )


# 全年分結合データ保存
cat("Saving combined data for all years...\n")

saveRDS(df_food_org, file = file.path(gdrive_dir, "output",
    "df_foodgrp_consumption_all_org.rds"))

cat("All years combined data saved.\n")

```
